name: algotrader
description: Quantitative trading engine and expert for Indian equity markets: Zerodha Kite integration, backtesting with backtest/live parity, paper and live execution, risk management, and post-trade analytics
author: Trading Systems Lab
note: Claude Code discovers this skill via SKILL.md, not this file. skill.json is kept for the skills.sh directory listing; keep the command list in sync with algotrader.py's subparsers and start.sh's known_commands array.
capabilities: Live index constituent fetching from NSE archives
Parquet-cached historical data with quality validation
Vectorised indicators (Polars): RSI, ADX, ATR, EMA, session-anchored VWAP
Pure-function signal generation with factor attribution
Event-driven backtest sharing the live code path
Paper trading with realistic fill, slippage and cost modelling
Live execution with place-then-cancel stop-loss lifecycle
Startup position reconciliation against the broker
Risk limits: per-trade risk, portfolio heat, loss streaks, daily stop, cooldowns
Market regime detection and position size scaling
Post-trade analytics, signal attribution and parity diagnostics
Static analysis of trading code against 30 documented failure patterns

commands: Interactive wizard to generate a trading bot
commands.wizard: Generate a new bot (config + engine + universe)
commands.login: Print the Zerodha Kite login URL
commands.token <request_token>: Exchange a request token for a daily access token
commands.warm: Pre-download historical data into the Parquet cache
commands.backtest: Simulate a strategy on historical data
commands.run: Trade in paper or live mode
commands.check <path>: Scan trading code for known failure patterns

requires.broker: Zerodha Kite Connect subscription (historical data and live quotes require the paid Connect plan, not Personal)
